account.description: Account, subscription, project, cluster or org id the resource lives in. Part of the fingerprint.

canonical_id.description: nimbus catalog id (S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET). Optional on ingest: the catalog maps source+check_id onto it, else it becomes UPPER(source):check_id.

check_id.description: The tool's native check id (s3_bucket_public_access, CKV_AWS_20, CVE-2024-3094). Part of the fingerprint.

compliance.description: Framework key → control ids (cis_aws: ["2.1.4"]). Merged with the catalog's mappings.

description.description: Longer explanation or the tool's status detail.

file.description: IaC file path relative to the scanned root (IaC findings only). Part of the fingerprint.

first_seen.description: RFC 3339 time the finding was first observed (set by nimbus when absent).

id.description: Stable fingerprint. Optional on ingest: when empty nimbus computes it as hex(sha256(source|check_id|provider|account|region|resource.id|file))[:32].

last_seen.description: RFC 3339 time of the latest observation (set by nimbus on ingest).

line_end.description: Last line of the offending block.

line_start.description: First line of the offending block (1-based).

provider.description: aws | azure | gcp | oci | kubernetes | github | m365 | okta | iac | unknown (aliases such as k8s, azurerm, terraform are normalised).

raw.description: The tool's original record, kept verbatim for evidence. Never rendered as HTML.

region.description: Cloud region or location, when the resource is regional. Part of the fingerprint.

resource.description: The affected resource (for IaC: the Terraform address).

scan_id.description: Id of the scan that produced the finding (set by nimbus).

severity.description: Upper-case severity. Native ingest does not normalise other spellings (adapters do); empty means INFO, and an INFO finding takes the catalog severity.

source.description: Producing tool in lower case (prowler, checkov, trivy, steampipe, scoutsuite, cloud-posture, or a plugin name). Part of the fingerprint.

status.description: FAIL = open misconfiguration, PASS = checked and fine, SKIP = muted/manual/not applicable, ERROR = could not be evaluated (scan gaps carry tags.scan_gap and fail closed).

tags.description: Free-form string labels. Reserved: account_label, scan_gap, service, cvss, primary_url.

title.description: One-line human title. Filled from the catalog when empty.

weaknesses.description: Weakness vocabulary consumed by the attack-path engine (PUBLIC_DATA_STORE, IMDSV1_ENABLED, ...). Filled from the catalog.

attr.description: Edge attributes copied onto the graph edge; attr.because (string) becomes the hop's explanation.

kind.description: Edge kind: attached_to, runs_as, bound_to, member_of, trusts, has_policy, grants_access_to, runs_on, allows_traffic_to, can_assume, exposes, contains, stores_data_in, or an alias (policy → has_policy, resource → grants_access_to, sts_assume_role_allows → can_assume reversed, exposed_to_internet → exposes from the internet). Unknown kinds are kept as unverified attached_to hints.

attributes.description: Collector or tool attributes used by rules and the graph (public, versioning, ...).

id.description: Provider-native resource id (ARN, Azure resource id, GCP self link, Kubernetes <namespace>/<kind>/<name>, Terraform address). Part of the fingerprint and the graph node id.

related.description: Related resource ids. On ingest an entry is either a string (an untyped hint, becomes an attached_to edge) or a typed relation object {id, kind, attr}. nimbus writes strings here and the typed entries again under relations.

relations.description: Typed relationships from this resource (the form nimbus writes). Each id is also listed in related.

type.description: Resource type in Terraform naming where one exists (aws_s3_bucket, kubernetes_pod).

description: Native ingest and output format of nimbus (cloud-posture), spec version 1.0.0. A document is either this envelope, a JSON array of findings, or JSON lines of findings. Generated from internal/model by `go generate ./internal/output`; do not edit by hand. Human-readable spec: docs/spec/finding-v1.md.
